description: Header file defining structures, macros, enums, and function prototypes for the Linux driver of Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA, including device info, hardware operations, and reset/clock/gpio configurations.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_num_get
methods.description: Returns the total number of attached Endpoint devices.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_req
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific EP device by index and interrupt module.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_release
methods.description: Releases the reference to a specific EP device.
